# Support performance

SLA compliance and resolution-time analysis for `mart_support_performance`
(MongoDB-sourced). Tickets still open are censored, not "slow" — dropping them
biases every average.

## SLA trend

Compliance rate per month with Wilson intervals.

```{r}
#| echo: false
trend <- read_table("support_sla_trend")
if (!is.null(trend)) print(trend) else cat("No SLA trend table in this run.\n")
```

## Resolution times

Resolution times are right-skewed; summaries use log-scale geometric mean and
median (`log_time_summary()`). Open tickets require survival methods.

## Workload

`workload_balance()` flags agents with robust z-scores on load. Mixed models
(`lme4::lmer`) are the next step for agent/queue effects.
